in_hebrew.name: יהושן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהושן הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים ישלח ישועה לעמו'. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'יהו' (קיצור של יהוה) ו'ושן' (נגזר מישועה). השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הקהילות היהודיות והנוצריות כאחד, ויש לו קונוטציות של ישועה והצלה.

in_greek.name: Ἰηοσάν
in_greek.meaning: ὁ Θεός ἐξαποστείλει σωτηρίαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰηοσάν ἐστιν ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκόν, ᾧ ἡ σημασία εἶναι 'ὁ Θεός ἐξαποστείλει σωτηρίαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ'. Ἐκ τῶν λέξεων 'Ἰηο' (σύντομος μορφή τοῦ Θεοῦ) καὶ 'σάν' (προερχόμενον ἀπό σωτηρίαν) ἀποτελεῖται. Τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο χρῆται εἰς Ἰουδαίους καὶ Χριστιανούς, καὶ εἶναι σύνδεσμος σωτηρίας καὶ ἀ救ῆς.

in_latin.name: Yehoshan
in_latin.long_meaning: Yehoshan nomen Hebraeum est, cuius significatio est 'Deus mittet salvationem populo suo'. Componitur ex vocibus 'Yeho' (abbreviatio Dei) et 'shan' (a salus derivatum). Nomen hoc apud Iudaeos et Christianos in usu est, et connotationes salvationis et liberationis habet.

in_english.name: Yehoshan
in_english.meaning: God sends salvation to his people
in_english.long_meaning: Yehoshan is a Hebrew name meaning 'God sends salvation to his people'. Derived from the Hebrew roots 'Yeho' (a shortened form of God) and 'shan' (from salvation), this name signifies divine deliverance and rescue. Historically used among Jewish and Christian communities, Yehoshan conveys spiritual significance, symbolizing faith and redemption. In modern times, it remains a meaningful choice for Christian parents seeking a name rich in biblical heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yehoshan holds cultural significance in Jewish tradition, as it is a name from the Hebrew Bible and a part of Jewish history. It may be used in contemporary Jewish communities as a given name, further connecting tradition to the present.
data.spiritual_significance: Yehoshan bears a spiritual significance being a name that symbolizes God's grace and goodness. Its use serves as a reminder that every aspect of life is a result of God's graciousness, and individuals may turn to Yehoshan as a reminder of the divine presence that ever-extends grace throughout life. Additionally, it represents the deep Jewish foundation that the Christian faith is rooted in and reinforces the spiritual bond between Jewish and Christian traditions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yehoshan, meaning "God is gracious," is a name that evokes the profound blessings and kindness bestowed upon us by God. It serves as a reminder of His unwavering love and compassion, inspiring us to extend the same grace to others in our lives.

historical_references.reference: The name Yehoshan appears in the Old Testament as a variant of the name Josiah. Josiah was a king of Judah who reigned from 640 to 609 BC. He is best known for his religious reforms, which included the destruction of idolatrous altars and the restoration of the Temple in Jerusalem.

In the New Testament, there is a figure named Joseph, who is believed to be the earthly father of Jesus. The name Joseph is a Hebrew name derived from the root yosheth, meaning 'God will add'. The name Yehoshan, as a variant of Josiah, may have influenced the naming of Joseph.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yehoshan (יְהוֹשָׁן), derived from the Hebrew language, is gaining popularity in modern contexts, particularly in Jewish communities. This name, which translates to 'God has given' or 'God is gracious', is seen on various platforms such as social media, baby naming websites, and within Jewish communities. The revival of traditional Jewish names, as well as an increasing interest in biblical names, has contributed to the modern usage of Yehoshan. While it may not be as common as more popular names, its significance and meaning continue to resonate with those seeking to connect with their cultural and religious heritage.
